_note: All inputs for the scenario analysis. Every value has a source or is labelled ASSUMPTION. Replace assumptions with better public data where available.

category_mix._source: ASSUMPTION. Results are reported per category, so the mix only affects totals.

grid_emission_factor_kgco2_per_kwh._source: DOE, Philippine Energy Plan 2023-2050 Vol. III, Table 7: Luzon-Visayas simple operating margin, 2019-2021 = 0.6935 tCO2/MWh.
grid_emission_factor_kgco2_per_kwh._alt_source: Same table: Luzon-Visayas combined margin (wind and solar), 2019-2021 = 0.7058 tCO2/MWh.

electricity._list_source: Residential electricity rates of 113 distribution utilities (101 on-grid, 12 off-grid), October 2026, Institute for Climate and Sustainable Cities, PRESYO-PH National Overview, https://presyo.icsc.ngo/national (accessed 20 Nov 2026; archived https://web.archive.org/web/20261120151637/https://presyo.icsc.ngo/national). Transcribed from the 'Highest and lowest residential electricity rates' table. Only on-grid utilities are used; each utility is equally likely (unweighted, no customer counts). Methods A and B use the unweighted mean of the list.
electricity._synthetic_note: Used only when tariff_source = 'synthetic' (previous design, kept as a sensitivity case): n_distribution_utilities spread evenly between tariff_min and tariff_max.
electricity._min_source: ALECO Residential Mainland rate, October 2026, Albay Electric Cooperative, Inc., Power rates for October 2026, https://web.alecoinc.com.ph/rates.php (accessed 20 Nov 2026; archived https://web.archive.org/web/20261120055333/https://web.alecoinc.com.ph/rates.php). Illustrative LOW bound, not the national minimum.
electricity._max_source: Meralco overall rate for a typical household, October 2026 (P15.0615/kWh), as stated in Manila Electric Company, Higher residential rates this November 2026 [press release, 13 Nov 2026], archived https://web.archive.org/web/20261120060936/https://www.meralco.com.ph/media/advisories/higher-residential-rates-this-november-2026. Illustrative HIGH bound, not the national maximum.
electricity._du_note: ASSUMPTION: 20 synthetic distribution utilities with tariffs spread evenly between the two published bounds.
electricity._within_du_note: ASSUMPTION: each customer's effective tariff varies uniformly by +/-5% around its utility's published rate (customer class, monthly adjustments, refunds). The registry used by method C holds only the published rate.
electricity._kwh_source: Meralco 'typical household' consumption of 200 kWh/month used in its rate announcements (e.g., Meralco press release, 13 Nov 2026).

fuel._exclude_note: false = use every price as DOE reported it. true = drop the two flagged outliers (robustness check).
fuel._price_source: Department of Energy (DOE), Price Monitoring of Liquid Fuels, week of 20-26 October 2026: NCR (Oil Industry Management Bureau); North Luzon (CAR and Regions I-III, Luzon Field Office); South Luzon (Regions IV-A, IV-B and V, Oil Industry Management Bureau); Visayas (Regions VI-VIII and NIR, Visayas Field Office); Mindanao (Regions IX-XIII and BARMM, Mindanao Field Office). One overall range (lowest-highest across brands) per monitored city or municipality; see data/doe_fuel_SOURCE.txt. Regular diesel = DIESEL row; gasoline = all grades (RON 91-100). Each of the five DOE areas is equally likely, then each monitored location within the area (ASSUMPTION: no sales volumes). Each location's range is recomputed from the brand columns (the report's OVERALL RANGE column omits a brand or is shifted by one row in 16 rows; both are kept in the CSV). Two outliers are flagged but kept as reported: diesel P55.80/L (Bangued City, Abra) and RON 97 P158.30/L (Ozamiz City).
fuel._range_note: Used only when price_source = 'range' (robustness check): DOE NCR overall ranges for the same week, regular diesel P88.00-98.50/L and gasoline across grades P75.10-101.10/L.
fuel._ef_source: Derived from IPCC 2006 Guidelines Vol. 2 Ch. 1 defaults: CO2 EF 74,100 kg/TJ (gas/diesel oil) and 69,300 kg/TJ (motor gasoline); NCV 43.0 and 44.3 TJ/Gg. Densities 0.84 and 0.74 kg/L are ASSUMPTIONS. CO2 only (CH4, N2O excluded).

scenarios._note: p = share of messages carrying a usable purpose code (ELEC / FUEL). q = share of coded electricity messages whose creditor ID resolves to a known distribution utility in the institution's registry.

iso_codes._fuel_note: FUEL (Fuel/Gas) is registered in ExternalPurpose1Code since 2026-08-28 via CR1639 (Federal Reserve Financial Services), per the ISO 20022 External Code Sets file checked on 20 Nov 2026. Adoption by PESONet/InstaPay is not known.

portfolio._note: ASSUMPTION. PCAF attribution factors (outstanding loan / total assets) for the simulated MSME borrowers, used only for the portfolio check: lognormal with sigma 1.0, scaled to a mean of 0.3 and capped at 1. Estimate and truth share each factor, so the factors only weight borrower errors.
